hooks.name: Check backend Python on save
hooks.description: Runs ruff on the saved backend/*.py file and mypy (strict) when it is under backend/app. Tools come from EVIDENCE_PROGRAMS_ROOT via configs/development-toolchain.json, never from PATH. Result PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED goes to stdout and .agents/hook-logs/kiro-hooks.log. Kiro fires PostFileSave for editor saves and for agent writes (fs_write, str_replace, fs_append), so no PostToolUse hook is needed.
